name: Expose navigation to Nyx as lantern:::navigation
body: Host API: build from the loaded level, `FindPath(from, to)` returning a path object (point count, point, link kind per point, whether it reaches the goal, nearest reachable spot when it doesn't), `IsReachable`, and debug drawing. Update engine-host-surface.json and docs/game-api.md; the host-surface test checks them.
